headline.title: A quiet Friday, with some paperwork outstanding
headline.quip: Nothing new collapsed today, which leaves the systems free to spend the weekend drafting their post-incident reports.
headline.summary: The archivist found no major disruption that began on November 20 and could be verified with two independent sources. Some source pages could not be opened during research.

reasons: Web searches surfaced no disruption starting on November 20, but a source page could not be opened (network restriction), so the search was incomplete.
A Microsoft final report on the November 12-13 outage was reportedly due November 20; it was not verified and is not a new disruption.
